info.title: API.SH: IndiaMART
info.description: The IndiaMART API from API.SH: public IndiaMART data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products and suppliers of an IndiaMART category page, India-wide or in one city, optionally only manufacturers, exporters, wholesalers or retailers: category name, parent and group, total products, breadcrumbs, each product (id, title, link, price and unit text, image, description, specifications, supplier with city, rating and count, years listed, GST number and verification, TrustSEAL, phone, response rate, website and page) plus the featured listings, price ranges, related categories and the cities that have this category. IndiaMART shows the first page of a category to visitors.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indiamart-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug, the indiamart.com/impcat/<slug>.html part; a full category link also works.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Only suppliers in this city (e.g. mumbai, delhi, ahmedabad, chennai; slugs from the cities list).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indiamart-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric product id (the number at the end of an indiamart.com/proddetail/ URL), or pass `url`.

get.description:
B2B products and suppliers for a search on IndiaMART (India): title, price and unit, specifications, images, categories, and the supplier (city, state, rating and rating count, member since, business type, GST number and verification, response rate, phone, website). Filter by city and business type. IndiaMART shows logged-out visitors only the first page of results (10), so `next_page` is always null; narrow with `city` or `business_type` for other results.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indiamart-search

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Indian city to search in (e.g. Mumbai, Delhi, Pune).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indiamart-suggest

get.description:
An IndiaMART supplier's company page: name, page title and description, city, state and address, contact person and designation, business phone, GST number and verification, membership, member since, products or services, nature of business, legal status, employees, annual turnover, year established, CIN and the rest of the factsheet, main category and product categories, HSN codes, rating, and the products listed on the page (id, name, description, price, unit, image, category, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indiamart-supplier

parameters.description: The supplier's page name (the part after indiamart.com/, e.g. `tata-steel-limited`), instead of `url`.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
